profile_text.body:
IBM is a public company founded in 1911 and headquartered in Armonk, NY, USA, trading under the ticker IBM. Its most recent 10-K, covering the period ending 2025-12-31, reports revenue of $67,535,000,000. The page harvested from its site covers IBM OpenPages, which the company describes as a scalable, AI-powered governance, risk and compliance platform available on any cloud or on-premises, built modularly so organizations can deploy only the components they need.

IBM's AI products include IBM OpenPages with Watson, described as a full GRC platform with AI-specific modules for risk assessment, regulatory mapping and automated documentation; IBM watsonx.governance, for AI lifecycle governance, model evaluation, monitoring and documentation, with EU AI Act accelerators; and IBM watsonx, an enterprise AI platform the company describes as model-agnostic. The site says OpenPages can connect watsonx.ai or other models through an API-based architecture, and it describes an OpenPages MCP Server that lets AI agents create, query and update GRC objects. It also cites the IDC MarketScape Worldwide AI-Enabled Financial Governance, Risk, and Compliance 2026 Vendor Assessment, in which the company says IDC recognized IBM as a leader, and a Citi partnership to automate internal audit work using AI and machine learning.

The litigation exposure listed for IBM in New York is 424 cases. The product record also notes that watsonx.governance was named a Leader in Gartner's first AI Governance Platforms Magic Quadrant in June 2026.
